description: Daily Bitcoin network series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own Bitcoin full node: hash rate, difficulty, transaction count, unique addresses, coin days destroyed, NVT ratio, miner revenue in BTC and fee rates. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf and age.

days.description: How many latest daily points to return (1–365).

metric.description: One daily series. Omit to get the latest value of every series.

name: btc_network_metrics
title: Bitcoin network metrics
